summary: Diff adds a Book Reader module with new pages (library/reader/editor), React Query hooks for book/sentence CRUD, in-browser speechSynthesis TTS controls (play/stop/autoplay, rate/pitch, zh-CN, fallback UI), theme styling for reading pages, backend types/state migration for books, and navigation entry. However, deterministic sentence ordering/reordering support is not clearly implemented, and the required generated image asset file itself is not evidenced as added. Several unrelated features (Android build assets/config, member age display, attendance absence toasts, financial/groups tweaks) were also introduced beyond the request.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must define stable Motoko types for books/lessons and sentence entries with deterministic ordering (e.g., explicit index/order field).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows Book includes `sentences : [Sentence]`, but the `Sentence` type shown has no explicit `order`/`index` field, so deterministic ordering beyond array position is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Editor UI must support reordering sentences for a book/lesson (persisted via backend CRUD).
missing_requirements.reason: Editor page shows sentence CRUD fields and a `GripVertical` icon, but the diff snippet does not show any implemented reorder UI logic or a corresponding backend/hook method to persist sentence order changes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add generated static image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` (including the required book cover) and reference them from the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: UI references `/assets/generated/book-cover.dim_1200x1600.png`, but the diff summary does not show the image file(s) actually added under `frontend/public/assets/generated`.

hallucinated_features.description: Android/Capacitor packaging additions (Capacitor config + Android icon preloads) unrelated to the Book Reader requirements.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for a Book Reader module and a generated book cover asset; it did not request Android packaging work or Android icon assets.

hallucinated_features.description: Unrelated feature changes: member age column/utility, attendance consecutive-absence toast notifications, and financial/groups page enhancements.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly focused on adding the Book Reader module alongside existing routes/pages, not changing existing domain features.

hallucinated_features.description: Additional generated assets referenced in layout/header (e.g., header pattern, app logo) beyond the requested book cover image.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-11 only requires generated assets for the Book Reader module (explicitly the book cover). The diff indicates extra generated images being used globally.
